admission: Measured catalogue and exact owned Pod/source/runtime bindings required. Core24 first; no automatic dispatch of all64. Infrastructure/resource limits may defer cases without relabeling them failures.
allocation_basis: 85 integration minimum plus prospective speed/side/reactivity/occlusion branch coverage. Fixed fixtures are not iid samples or a power calculation.
empty_road_controls: Retain the separate 743 empty-road 5/10/15 m/s controls for both consumers; unattempted controls remain pending.
evidence_required: Raw contact and progress reconstruction including policy-error tails
Detection/localization/association traces with explicit matching sensitivity
geometry_tolerance_basis: Inherited 1e-4 m floating-point transform consistency envelope; not a contact/safety tolerance or an IEEE requirement.
initialization: Sensors spawn before the existing20settlingticks. Two recorded coastticks follow one velocity assignment. Listener subscriptions and base clock remain at the original post-coast point. Registration requires snapshot presence and preserves observations before validation.
outcome_rule: Physical contact S; clipped actual forward displacement/(30*v), frozen at earliest contact/policy failure/horizon. Failure tail remains observed; incomplete evidence uses [0,1] bounds.
perception: Original86checkpoint/CenterPoint/ten-sweep policy, intensity1, phase91noise law and driving_binding92seed namespace. Materialized122/125CANMOT axialinnovation repair is common to both consumers; Q/R unchanged. All detector outputs retained.
qualification_scope: Development integration only. No method-benefit or paper GO from this protocol.
retention: Preserve every attempted case. Fresh-process repeats are specified before outcomes, not retries selected for a favorable result.
timing: 20Hzsensor/directcontrol;10Hzplanner;2Hzdetector. Common warmup commands at-1,1,...,97;firstassessment decision99affectsinterval100. Preserve common measured histories throughrow99 and newwarmup controls throughrow98. Base clock atpost-coast observation.
